title: [review] tx_queue.py:416: confirm_transmitted() updates
description: _remove_first() called by confirm_transmitted() increments packets_transmitted and updates latency stats, but never calls reservation.set_result(). If an entry with a reservation is removed via confirm_transmitted(), the awaiting caller hangs forever because the Future is never resolved. The complete() method correctly signals the reservation at line 517 after updating stats.
close_reason: Fixed: _remove_first() now calls reservation.set_result(True) so confirm_transmitted() path signals the Future. All 146 tx_queue tests pass.
